resources.string: Type your relay\'s address in Settings and test it. Search, Recent and Continue turn on as soon as it answers.
The app can notify you when a new episode of the series you follow in Continue Watching comes out. You can change this anytime in Settings.
Type a title and press Search. Filters also apply to the search, and with filters you can search without a title.
You can pick several options in each filter: series that match any of them are shown. The minimum score applies to the results already loaded.
Series you play with this identity will appear here, at the second where you left them.
It\'s also removed from Continue on your other devices with this identity.

On a series page, hold an episode to download it with its subtitles and watch it offline.

This relay doesn\'t support the remote yet. Update it to the latest version.
No TVs connected. Open Relaycast on the TV with a profile linked to this identity.
Only TVs that are on and waiting for this identity\'s commands are listed, also from another network: commands go through the relay. The app remembers the chosen TV until you press Disconnect.
Another network · controlled through the relay
%1$s is not available. Turn on the TV and open Relaycast with a profile linked to this identity.
The TV isn\'t playing anything. On a series page, use “Watch on TV” to start an episode there.
The TV only starts episodes with Relaycast on screen. To have it open by itself, press “Open from the phone” in the TV app.
This phone already uses that profile.

If you continue, the app will connect to the relay %1$s.

Done: the TV now has the profile “%1$s”.
The TV uses the relay %1$s, which is not the one set up here. Set up and test that same relay in Settings and scan the code again.
The TV will use this phone\'s active identity: the same Continue Watching history and the same preferences. It will appear on the TV as a profile.
Set up the relay address first.
No connection to the relay: you can only watch downloaded episodes.
Offline: you can only watch downloaded episodes.

resources.string: You\'re up to date: you watched episode %1$d. It will show here when the next one is out in %2$s.
Install Google Translate to translate the synopsis.
%1$s This relay requires an account: create or import one in Account.
%1$s Search, Recent and Continue are now available.
Type only the domain or IP, with the port if needed (for example relay.mydomain.com or 192.168.1.20:8787). The address is saved when the test succeeds.
First test and save the relay address
The code contains this profile\'s identity: whoever scans it gets its Continue Watching and preferences. Show it only on your own devices or to someone who should share them.
Name shown on the other phone
On the other phone, open Relaycast › Settings › Scan code, or point the camera at it.

The token defines your history and preferences. It\'s stored encrypted on this phone, only for this address; share it only with the devices that should share the list and settings. The TV code can be a profile (“Take to phone”) or a TV link.
In Japanese, Continue Watching keeps the English name and shows the Japanese title below it. Hide +18 series removes those rated R+ or Rx from Recent and Search.
Sub declares Japanese audio and turns on subtitles; Dub declares English audio. These preferences belong to the active identity and sync through the relay to your other devices.
Android does not allow alerts from this app. Turn them on in the system settings → Notifications.
The episodes will no longer be available offline.

A download is deleted only when you finish watching that episode (reaching the outro or its last minutes), here or on another device with the same identity. Opening another episode doesn\'t delete it. Alerts arrive once the catalog has published a new episode of the series in Continue Watching (in the Sub or Dub kind you follow), never by the estimated time: the app checks when it opens and every hour in the background.
Anyone with this token can access the associated history and preferences. Don\'t send it by message, email or screenshot without protection.

Changing the token makes you a different user. The current history and preferences stay on the server, but this phone won\'t be able to open them again without the current token. There is no account recovery.
I already saved the current token safely
Import another device\'s token only if you want to access exactly the same history and the same preferences.
I understand this replaces the current identity
The token must contain 64 hexadecimal characters.
The administrator token is used only once to register this identity; it isn\'t stored on the phone. Then back up the new token: it can\'t be recovered if you lose it.
Your library and progress are stored on your device and server. See the policy for details about third-party services.
Looking for Cast devices on this Wi‑Fi…
The phone and the Chromecast or Google TV must be on the same network, and the TV must be able to open your relay\'s address (the same home network, or public HTTPS).
Couldn\'t connect to the Cast device.
The Cast device couldn\'t play the episode. Check that it can reach the relay (same network or public HTTPS).

Downloads play on this phone. Play the episode online to cast it.

It opens here, next to the list.
The code has the relay\'s address. Next, sign in with your account or create a new one.
The code has the relay\'s address and its administrator token. Next, sign in with your account (recommended) or create a new one. The administrator token is not stored on the phone.
This phone uses %1$s. Connecting to the new relay leaves that identity behind.
Another device sent this episode; you can control it here.
Casting goes on even if you close or update the app: come back here to control it or open it in the player.
Play an episode and it shows on the Cast device.
Choose the Chromecast or TV and play an episode.

Alerts arrive once the catalog has published a new episode of the series in Continue Watching (in the Sub or Dub kind you follow), never by the estimated time: the app checks when it opens and every hour in the background.

A download is deleted only when you finish watching that episode (reaching the outro or its last minutes), here or on another device with the same identity. Opening another episode doesn\'t delete it.
The name and picture show on your phones and on this identity\'s TVs. The email is kept on the relay to recover the profile later; no emails are sent for now.
Without a photo, the profile shows this color with the emoji or the name\'s initial.
For example relay.mydomain.com or 192.168.1.20:8787. HTTP works only on your local network.
The token is your account\'s key: back it up and share it only with your devices.
They show on your phones and on your account\'s TVs.

Removes them from Recent and Search (R+ and Rx ratings).
Sub: Japanese audio with subtitles. Dub: English audio.
When a new episode of a series in Continue Watching is out, in Sub or Dub as you follow it.
When you finish the episode, here or on another device of your account.
To recover the account later. No emails are sent for now.
Couldn\'t translate it (the language model needs a connection the first time).
In a few steps: connect your relay, set up your account and your profile. Each step can be left for later.
Scan the setup code your relay\'s administrator gave you, or type its address.
That code is for linking a TV. Here, scan the relay\'s setup code or a profile code.
It keeps your Continue Watching and preferences on the relay. Create a new one, or use the one from another device.
A name and a picture, so you can tell it apart on your phones and TVs.
Recent, Search and Continue are ready. You can change everything in Settings.
You can connect your relay anytime from Settings or from this assistant.
No QR code was found in the image.
Relay ready: %1$s. Now identify this phone with your account.
Recommended: on a device with your account, open Settings › Show profile code (or on the TV, hold OK on your profile › Take to phone) and scan it, or choose a screenshot of it.
Uses the setup code\'s administrator token; it is not stored on the phone.
You\'ll need the relay\'s administrator token.
That isn\'t a profile code. Scan the code of your profile (Settings › Show profile code, or Take to phone on the TV).
With Google translation on this device, into its language, when the subtitles are in another one. The first time it downloads the language.
Downloading the language to translate the subtitles…
Play your videos from this device, your servers or your shared folders. No account needed.
One line from ssh-keyscan or the server\'s /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub, like \"ssh-ed25519 AAAA…\". The app only connects to a server with this key.
Include the shared folder: smb://server/share. For a domain account write DOMAIN\\user; leave the user empty for guest access.
Choose a video or audio file on this device or on a drive it can open.
Choose a folder on this device, a memory card or a USB drive. The app only reads that folder.
